title: BrandArchitectInput
description: Input schema for the AI Brand Architect skill

brand_name.description: Company, product, campaign, event, IP, or brand name

industry.description: Industry or category, such as AI design tools, hospitality, finance, education, fashion, cultural creative products, or consumer apps

product.description: What the brand makes, sells, enables, or changes for users

target_users.description: Primary audience, tribe, buyer, user, or community

founder_story.description: Founder story, origin story, founding belief, or reason the brand exists

brief.description: Additional brand context, market context, personality, constraints, usage surfaces, competitors, or desired direction

competitors.description: Optional competitor or adjacent brand names used for distance checks

research_depth.description: How deeply to develop archaeology, symbol discovery, and scoring

visual_identity_scope.description: How far to take the final visual expression

target_platform.description: Which image model prompts to emphasize

render_image.description: When true, generate an actual identity image after Brand DNA if an image-generation tool is available

examples.product: A thinking-first AI design platform that helps creators turn ideas into visual identity systems.
examples.target_users: Independent creators, product founders, and small teams who need design judgment before visual execution.
examples.founder_story: The brand was created from the belief that design should return to thinking, not visual noise.
